messages:
katie: Thanks for the great all-hands. Opening a short thread to capture GTM + partnerships Qs and owners. I'll consolidate after.

emily: one ask - can we get the partner-sourced pipeline split by ARR band? want to understand ACV distribution.

ajay: for co-sell handoffs, what's the SLA we're standardizing on? some AEs are asking for clear timing.

sophie: proposal: raw leads -> AE queue within 4h, partner PMs get a 24h qual reminder. keeps AEs responsive and partners in the loop.

marc: forecasting question: are partner-influenced deals categorized differently in the weekly forecast? I saw mixed tagging.

emily: not yet; ops will add a partner_influenced flag in the export and we'll sample the velocity differences.

dan: renewals ask: are we prioritizing Dedicated renewals top-10 this quarter? AE bandwidth is tight.

katie: yes, renewals top-10 are priority. sales ops will share the list and outreach templates by EOD.

ajay: marketing support request: can we get a joint case study template + NDAs checklist so partners can sign faster?

sophie: I'll draft the case study + NDAs checklist and share in the partner drive. aiming for Tue.

ops-bot: Recording + slides: All-Hands 2026-04-15 (https://redwood.app/records/ah-2026-04-15)

emily: action items summary: 1) partner ARR band CSV (Emily/Ops) 2) lead routing SLA doc (Sophie/Sales Ops) 3) partner flag in forecast export (Ops) 4) renewals list + templates (Sales Ops) 5) case study + NDA checklist (Sophie/Legal). I'll compile and post links.

katie: thanks everyone. I'll tag owners in the consolidated doc and close the loop in this thread.
